أمَنَةٌ : see أَمْنٌ, in two places: ―
-b2- and see also أَمَانَةٌ. ＝
-A2- Also A man who trusts, or confides, in every one; (T, S, M;) and so ↓ أُمَنَةٌ : (S:) and who believes in everything that he hears; who disbelieves in nothing: (Lh, T:) or in whom men, or people, trust, or confide, and whose malevolence, or mischievousness, they do not fear: (T, M:) and ↓ أُمَنَةٌ signifies trusted in, or confided in; [like أَمِينٌ;] and by rule should be أُمْنَةٌ, because it has the meaning of a pass. part. n. [like لُعْنَةٌ and ضُحْكَةٌ and لُقْطَلةٌ &c. (see لَقَطٌ)]: (M:) or both signify one in whom every one trusts, or confides, in, or with respect to, everything. (K.) ―
-b2- See also أَمِينٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
